name: Goros
bio: Goros is the living remnant of the fury of doomed soldiers. The Ironband of Redcrag Fortress ritually consigned themselves to annihilation, so long as they could destroy their besiegers. The ritual worked: they invoked Goros… and it was the sole “survivor" on either side.
subtitle: Wrath of Ironfire
